title: PluginEnabledPayload
description: Payload for envelope.type === 'plugin.enabled'. Loombre Plugin Protocol (LPP) v1, Lane W2 (LD4): emitted in the SAME transaction whenever plugins.enabled flips true — a manual admin re-enable (packages/db/src/query/plugins.ts's setPluginEnabledAndEmit) or a re-approval after a scope-change auto-disable (reapprovePluginAndEmit). No `reason` field (unlike plugin.disabled) — there is exactly one path to 'enabled', an explicit admin action. ADMIN-ONLY delivery, mirroring settings.updated exactly.

pluginId.description: The plugins.id row that was enabled.

enabledAtMs.description: Epoch ms this row was updated to enabled=true.
